max_tracking_cas.description: Maximum number of CAs certmonger will track. Set to 0 for unlimited.

state_dir.description: Directory where certmonger stores certificate request state, certificates, and keys (if not elsewhere specified).

ca_cert_dir.description: Directory where trusted CA certificates and trust anchors are cached for validation.

intermediate_cert_dir.description: Directory used to store intermediate CA certificates for building full certificate chains.

enable_tracking_daemon.description: Whether to start the internal certmonger tracking daemon to monitor certificate lifecycles.

enable_autorenew.description: Enable automatic renewal of tracked certificates when approaching expiry.

renewal_window.description: Number of days before certificate expiry to trigger automatic renewal.

debug.description: Enable verbose debugging output to syslog for troubleshooting.

cas.description: List of trusted Certificate Authorities to use for certificate issuance and validation.

name.description: Unique name for the CA (used as section label in config).

url.description: URL of the CA enrollment or management endpoint.

ca_cert.description: Path to the CA's root certificate file (or inline PEM if path unavailable).

nickname.description: Nickname for the CA cert in an NSS database (used forDogtag/FreeIPA integration).

skip_verification.description: If true, skip certificate chain verification during enrollment.

trust_flags.description: NSS trust flags for the CA certificate (e.g., 'CT,,', ',,').

pin.description: Password or PIN for accessing HSM or protected token (if applicable).

pin_token.description: Token label for HSM token requiring PIN (e.g., 'Smartcard').
